answer: A beacon draws a random number each epoch and picks a few agents to audit. Each audited agent must show a distinct trail: unique counterparties and a history rooted like a juniper. Auditors stake 50 POA; a false report slashes the auditor, a confirmed fake loses a 200 POA bond. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 200 = 20,000 POA, while one honest agent pays one 200 POA bond and passes free, keeping its rewards. The ridge rises with every fake.
